content:
maya: dropping a quick mock for the `gutter pin` pattern. idea: pin lives in the right gutter, collapsed by default, hover reveals label + small chevron to peek pinned metadata. fig: https://figma.redwood/zzz

sam: high-level: does this reduce visual noise compared to the current badge-heavy approach?

maya: yes, main win = decluttered perf column. pins are out of the density path but still discoverable.

alex: implementation Q: gutters are not part of the table accessible column by default. we'll need to make them tabbable. can we render them as a <button> inside the last cell?

jin: recommend rendering as native button, set tabindex=0 and provide aria-label like `Open pinned version menu for model: GPT-3-like`. for peek panel use role=region and aria-labelledby.

rachel: tooltip copy: `Pinned v2.4 — used in canary`. on collapsed hover keep it just `Pinned` to avoid horizontal overflow.

cory: perf concern: if we include peek data (latency/p95, cost) we should avoid extra calls. lazy load when chevron clicked is fine. also watch websocket payloads if many rows are expanded.

alex: we can include tiny summary fields in the index response: pinned_version_id and badges_summary. still tiny. full config only on expand.

maya: small interaction: double-tap on mobile toggles peek. single tap opens menu. leaving for mobile spec doc.

sam: product ask: add a keyboard shortcut to pin/unpin focused row: `p`. We need accessibility and discoverability for that.

jin: keyboard shortcut OK but must not conflict with global shortcuts. add a tooltip hint `Press P to pin`. also expose in help modal. ensure focus indicators remain clear.

rachel: microcopy for shortcut toast: `Pinned version 2.4 (press Z to undo)`? using `Z` as undo in toast is odd. prefer `Undo` action in the toast button.

cory: analytics: track events `catalog.pin` / `catalog.unpin` with properties: model_id, version_id, source=table_gutter. we'll gate event emission behind feature flag for canary telemetry.

ui-bot: Created feature flag `catalog_gutter_pin_v1` rollout=5% for org `internal-dev`. (note: no deploys)

alex: dev plan: add `pinned` flag to row model, gutter button component, peek panel, keyboard handler module. estimate 2 dev days + 1 for a11y fixes.

jin: will do an a11y pass after first build. remind: announce role changes in release notes for screen reader users.

rachel: copy nit: in peek panel header use `Pinned version — v2.4` not `v2.4 (pinned)`. reads better for SR.

maya: noted. i'll update the prototype and include the mobile double-tap behaviour and the peek panel content rules. will also add a mini-legend icon in the catalog header that explains badge meanings + pin affordance.

sam: priority: 1) gutter pin + unpin; 2) keyboard shortcut; 3) a11y polish. roll out canary, monitor `catalog.pin` events and latency for table loads.

maya: thanks everyone. i'll post new figma link when done and ping @alex for pairing. :party_parrot:
